transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name], and I'll be speaking with you today. Can you tell me what brings you in to see me?

Well... I'm just here because... my supervisor told me I needed to come in. I mentioned something to him, and he got worried. I've just been having these... thoughts, lately. Like maybe... maybe my family would just be better off if I didn't wake up tomorrow. It kind of spooked me, I guess. So... here I am.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not waking up tomorrow?
Maybe... about two weeks, I guess. Ever since my daughter left Georgia. She... she went off to the military. Just been feeling different since she left, I suppose.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you used to like?

Yeah, I guess so. I don't know. I used to... well, I used to mess with my tomato plants out back. And I'd spend time sanding wood at my workbench. Even watching the Falcons on Sunday, or just staying after church to talk to folks... I used to do all that. But lately... I don't know. I just look at all of it and it feels like... like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't have it in me right now.
Have you been feeling like you’re a burden to your family or that they’d be better off without you?

Yeah... I suppose so. I just... I keep going over her leaving in my head. Just telling myself I must have failed her somehow. Like... if I was a better father, maybe I would have done something different. I don't know. Just... yeah.
Have you made any specific plans about how you would end your life, or have you taken any steps toward doing that?

No... no specific plans. I haven't done anything like that. I just... well, like I said, I keep thinking they might be better off if I just didn't wake up. It... it bothered me enough that I finally mentioned it to my supervisor at work. That's why I'm here. But no... no plans.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, or have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep lately?
No, not really. I mean, I'm sleeping about the same as usual, I guess. Nothing... nothing really different.
Have you noticed yourself feeling slowed down or restless lately, like your thoughts are dragging or you can't sit still?

I guess so. Just... heavy. People at work keep asking if I'm sick. They say I'm walking slower... taking forever just to answer a simple question. I don't know. Just feels like... like my body is moving through mud, I guess.
Have you ever felt this way before, like this heaviness or loss of interest, or is this the first time you've experienced these feelings?

I suppose so. Just... well, looking back, I guess these low stretches have been coming around for about a year now. But... this one, right after my daughter moved out, it's just... it's hit me the hardest.
Between these low stretches you've been having over the past year, were there ever two months or more where you felt like yourself again, without these heavy feelings or loss of interest?
I don't know... maybe? I haven't really been keeping track of the time like that. Just kind of... getting through the days. I don't remember if there was a whole two months where things were fine.
Between the times you felt down over the past year, was there ever a stretch where you felt like yourself again for two months or more without these heavy feelings or loss of interest?

Like I just said... I really couldn't tell you. I don't mark this kind of thing down on a calendar. It all just kind of... runs together, I guess. I just go to work and come home. I can't give you an exact number of weeks.
Looking back over the past year, was there ever a time when you felt like yourself again — without the heavy feelings or loss of interest — for two full months or more?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. I already told you, I don't know. I don't keep track of the days like that. I just... I just don't know.
Looking back over the past year, was there ever a time when you felt like yourself again — without the heavy feelings or loss of interest — for two full months or more?
Look, doc... I'm not trying to be difficult here. I just... I really can't answer that. I don't know why you're asking me again. My answer hasn't changed. I just don't know.
Looking back over the past year, can you recall even one time when you felt like yourself again — without the heavy feelings or loss of interest — for at least two full months?
I just... I'm not answering this again. I told you, I don't know. I don't keep track. That's it.
Looking back, can you recall if there was ever a time when you felt like yourself again — without these heavy feelings or loss of interest — for at least two full months at a time?
I already gave you my answer. I don't have a different one for you. Can we just move on to something else?
Looking back, can you recall if there was ever a time when you felt like yourself again — without these heavy feelings or loss of interest — for at least two full months at a time?
Are you... are you reading off a script or something? I told you. I don't remember any two months. Just put down no if you need a box checked.
